summary.intent: Review and update codebase mapping, identify E2E testing gaps and capture as todos, analyze technical concerns and add remediation phases to the roadmap, then begin discussing Phase 28 (Code Hygiene & Logging) via the GSD manager.
summary.outcome: 6 new todos captured (4 E2E test improvements, 2 staging baseline tasks), 5 new roadmap phases added (28-32), Phase 28 context captured with custom logger design decision, and a lint-staged misconfiguration fixed that was corrupting `.planning/` markdown files on commit.

repo: Only 1 of 12 E2E specs (recovery.spec.ts) calls deleteTestAccount(); the remaining 11 leave orphaned test accounts after each run
deleteTestAccount() helper already exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts using DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' }
AES-CTR streaming is fully implemented with 35 unit tests but zero E2E tests; Phase 12.1 left a manual verification checklist that was never automated
CTR mode is selected for media files >256KB, GCM for everything else, controlled in streaming-crypto.service.ts
Service Worker intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs and handles HTTP Range requests for seeking (decrypt-sw.ts)
139 console.* calls exist across 29 files in apps/web/src/ (82 error, 27 warn, 18 log, 12 time/timeEnd); hooks.ts alone has 34 calls leaking Web3Auth SDK state
11 .catch(() => {}) silently swallow unpin failures; 3 non-unpin catches (audioContext.close(), dynamic import) are acceptable best-effort patterns
pino browser mode does not support redaction (Node.js only) and its Sentry integration is also Node.js only — custom wrapper is the correct choice for a privacy-focused web app
00-Preliminary-R&D/poc/ contains 89MB of committed node_modules and deprecated ipfs-http-client@60.0.1; already excluded from ESLint
lint-staged in package.json runs markdownlint --fix on all *.md files, which bypasses .markdownlintignore when explicit paths are passed — .planning/ files were being corrupted on every commit
STATE.md todo count was stale (showed 10 when actual count was 6 before new todos), leading to an incorrect 6+4=14 calculation

code.finding: deleteTestAccount() helper exists here but is only called in recovery.spec.ts; needs to be wired into afterAll of all 12 specs
CTR/GCM mode selection logic lives here; 256KB threshold determines streaming vs in-memory decryption
Service Worker handling /decrypt-stream/* with Range request support; Playwright can assert SW interception by checking request URLs
34 console.* calls (highest count), Web3Auth debug logging leaking SDK state; also contains actionable any casts: coreKit: any and loginParams: any
lint-staged markdownlint glob was '**/*.md' — changed to exclude .planning/ to prevent escaping of intentional characters like console.* in planning docs
Was missing .planning/*.md and .planning/codebase/ — only phase and milestone subdirs were excluded, causing top-level planning files to be linted

workflow: GSD manager init JSON can break if ROADMAP.md contains markdown-escaped characters (e.g. console.\* instead of console.*) — the gsd-tools.cjs parser is sensitive to this
lint-staged --fix hooks run after staging and can corrupt files before commit even when .markdownlintignore is set, because lint-staged passes explicit file paths that bypass ignore files
When updating STATE.md todo counts, always read the current count from the filesystem rather than adding to whatever number was in context — STATE.md can be stale

friction: STATE.md had a stale todo count (10) that caused an incorrect 6+4=14 display; required manual correction and re-commit
markdownlint lint-staged hook kept re-escaping console.* in ROADMAP.md on every commit attempt, requiring three separate fix commits before the root cause (lint-staged glob) was addressed
GSD manager init failed with JSON parse error due to escaped characters in ROADMAP.md, blocking the dashboard display until the markdown was fixed
AskUserQuestion returned empty response at one point during Phase 28 discussion, requiring retry
